:emptyset: The empty set — the set containing no elements.
:set: Set literal: elements listed inside braces.
:setcondition: Set-builder notation: elements satisfying a condition.
:bigcup: Union over a range with lower and upper bound.
:bigcap: Intersection over a range with lower and upper bound.
:setminus: Set difference — in the left set but not the right.
:triangle: Symmetric difference — in exactly one of the two sets.
:times: Cartesian product — the set of ordered pairs.
:dotcup: Disjoint union — a union of sets known to be disjoint.
:sqcup: Coproduct / disjoint union in the categorical sense.
:complement: Complement as a superscript C, typed after the set.
:powerset: Power set — the set of all subsets.
:subsetneq: Proper subset — contained in, but not equal to.
:subseteq: Subset or equal — every element of A lies in B.
:supsetneq: Proper superset — contains, but is not equal to.
:supseteq: Superset or equal — B contains every element of A.
:in: Membership — the element belongs to the set.
:ni: Reverse membership — the set contains the element.
:owns: Reverse membership; a readable alias for \ni.
:bbP: Blackboard P — the primes, or a probability measure.
:bbF: A field, typically a finite field.
:bbT: The torus, or the circle group.
:bbS: A sphere, or the surreal numbers.
:bbK: A generic base field, usually ℝ or ℂ.
